How many drug products in ChEMBL carry a black box warning?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE black_box_warning = 1
Which water bodies receive discharges under the most permits?

SELECT state_water_body_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_icis_permits WHERE state_water_body_name IS NOT NULL AND state_water_body_name <> '' AND state_water_body_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many appeals arose from judgments entered in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.originating_court_information WHERE substr(cast(date_judgment AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024'
What are unwanted calls most often about, by Do Not Call complaints?
SELECT subject, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.ftc_dnc_complaints WHERE subject IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

r: Calls pretending to be government, businesses, or family and friends
Reducing your debt (credit cards, mortgage, student loans)

How many registered clinical trials study prostate cancer?
SELECT count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_conditions WHERE lower(condition) LIKE '%prostate cancer%'
What do companies pay doctors for, ranked by dollars, in 2022?

SELECT nature_of_payment_or_transfer_of_value, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many jobs did Maricopa County, Arizona, have in 2022?
SELECT try_cast(_2022 AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_economy.bea_caemp25n WHERE geofips = '04013' AND linecode = '10'
Which arXiv categories appear on the most papers, cross-listings included?
SELECT category, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_categories GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many babies were born in Manhattan hospitals in 2016?

SELECT count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Manhattan' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE '%newborn%' AND cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016'
Which medical specialties write the most Medicare prescriptions for insulin glargine?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_type, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE gnrc_name LIKE 'Insulin Glargine%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What definition does ChEBI give for ethanol?
SELECT definition FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_compounds WHERE name = 'ethanol'

r: A primary alcohol that is ethane in which one of the hydrogens is substituted by a hydroxy group.

Which states have the most unequal incomes, by the Gini index?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS gini_index FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b19083' AND a.variable = 'B19083_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the total operating capacity of solar plants on the national map?
SELECT sum(try_cast(oper_cap AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' AND prim_fuel = 'SUN' AND try_cast(oper_cap AS double) > 0
How do New York's congressional districts rank by median household income?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_income FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '500%US36%' AND a.table_id = 'b19013' AND a.variable = 'B19013_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many transmission line segments carry 345 kilovolts?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_power_transmission_lines WHERE replace(voltage, '"', '') = '345'
Which industries win the most sub-contract dollars?

SELECT naics_description, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE subaward_type = 'sub-contract' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How was federal assistance split among grants, loans, insurance and direct payments in 2024?

SELECT assistance_type_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which industry codes have the most companies filing quarterly reports in 2024?
SELECT sic, count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE form = '10-Q' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns involved Toyota vehicles in 2010?
SELECT count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE maketxt = 'TOYOTA' AND substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2010'
What kinds of charter do active FDIC-insured institutions hold?

SELECT CASE bkclass WHEN 'N' THEN 'National bank' WHEN 'SM' THEN 'State member bank' WHEN 'NM' THEN 'State nonmember bank' WHEN 'SB' THEN 'Savings bank' WHEN 'SA' THEN 'Savings association' WHEN 'SL' THEN 'State savings institution' WHEN 'OI' THEN 'Insured branch of a foreign bank' ELSE bkclass END AS charter, count(*) AS institutions FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

r: Insured branch of a foreign bank

How many awards does a Grants.gov opportunity expect to make on average?
SELECT avg(try_cast(expectednumberofawards AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis WHERE try_cast(expectednumberofawards AS double) > 0
Which states had the largest total personal income in 2024?

SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS income_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE linecode = '1' AND geofips LIKE '%000' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds in PubChem carry a medical subject heading?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c0) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mesh

Are patent citations more often added by applicants or by examiners?
SELECT citation_category, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_us_patent_citation GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states had the largest current-dollar GDP in the first quarter of 2025?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(y2025_q1 AS double) AS gdp_millions FROM govblock_economy.bea_sqgdp1 WHERE linecode = '3' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do SEC operating companies divide by filer status, from large accelerated filers down?

SELECT category, count(*) AS companies, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE entitytype = 'operating' AND category <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

r:
Non-accelerated filer
Smaller reporting company
Emerging growth company

Which agencies bought the most from small businesses in New York last fiscal year?

SELECT awarding_agency_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025' AND contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size = 'SMALL BUSINESS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How old is the average operating nuclear reactor?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(current_reactor_age AS double)), 1) AS avg_age_years FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1
Which states have the most petroleum terminals?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_petroleum_terminals WHERE status = 'IN SERVICE' AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of federal contract actions in fiscal 2024 were firm fixed price?

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN type_of_contract_pricing = 'FIRM FIXED PRICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024'
In which states is energy most expensive per million Btu?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_million_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETCD.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Navy contract dollars in Virginia went to small businesses in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_sub_agency_name = 'DEPT OF THE NAVY' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'VA' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
What do federal campaigns spend money on most, by category?
SELECT category_desc, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
At which companies did insiders sell the most stock by value in 2023?

SELECT s.issuername, round(sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double) * try_cast(t.trans_pricepershare AS double))) AS dollars_sold FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s ON s.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'S' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which utilities earned the most revenue from commercial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(revenues_1 AS double) AS commercial_thousand_dollars FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

r: Los Angeles Department of Water & Power
